title: Formed-head geometry: standard torispherical proportions, depths, full volumes and surface areas

standardHeadProportions.note: dish radius = f*D, knuckle radius = k*D, D = the diameter the standard refers to (ASME F&D: outside diameter; llull applies it to the diameter the user names and records which one)

rows.name: ASME F&D
sources: S5 (Wikipedia 'Head (vessel)': crown radius = OD, knuckle 6 % of OD, ASME minimum)

rows.name: 2:1 semi-ellipsoidal, torispherical approximation
rows.use: documentation only; llull models a true 2:1 ellipsoid (a = D/4)

depthCases.source: S1 example via S2 (a_torispherical docstring and test)

fullHeadVolumeD1m.derivation: closed forms of [S1] (vertical head filled to its tangent line) and an independent numerical integration of pi*r(z)^2 over the crown-sphere + knuckle-torus profile (data/derive_expected.py, 200 000 slices); both agree to <= 3e-12 relative
fullHeadVolumeD1m.scaling: V scales with D^3 and depth with D for a fixed head type

rows.source: S2 test; formula S3 / Jones wetted area [S1]
Honeywell white paper example via S2 [S4]

surfaceArea.formulaEllipsoidal: oblate (a < R): SA = pi R^2 + (pi a^2 / (2 e)) ln((1+e)/(1-e)), e = sqrt(1 - a^2/R^2); prolate (a > R): SA = pi R^2 + (pi a R / e) asin(e), e = sqrt(1 - R^2/a^2); a = R: 2 pi R^2
